bip-dec.title: Declaration Base Information Package
bip-dec.description: Business to government submissions: import and export declarations, cargo reports, transit declarations.

top_level.name: Document acceptance date/time
top_level.definition: Date and time of acceptance of a document in accordance with governmental legislation.

top_level.name: Document/message cancellation date/time
top_level.definition: Date and time when the document/message was cancelled.

top_level.name: Document effective date/time
top_level.definition: Date and time of effectiveness of the document (e.g. license, visa, permit, certificate, bond).

top_level.name: Document expiration date/time
top_level.definition: Date and time of expiration of the document (e.g. license, visa, permit, certificate, bond).

top_level.name: Message function code
top_level.definition: Code specifying the function of a document.

top_level.name: Functional identifier
top_level.definition: Identification of a specific information exchange.

top_level.name: Document identifier
top_level.definition: Identification of a specific document.

top_level.name: Document issuing date/time
top_level.definition: Date and time the document was issued and when appropriate, signed or otherwise authenticated.

top_level.name: Document issuing location identifier
top_level.definition: Identification of the location at which a document was issued and when appropriate, signed or otherwise authenticated.

top_level.name: Language code
top_level.definition: Code specifying the language used or requested.

top_level.name: Document/message rejection date/time
top_level.definition: Date and time when the document/message was rejected.

top_level.name: Document/message status code
top_level.definition: Code specifying the status of a document.

top_level.name: Document name code
top_level.definition: Code specifying the name of a document.

top_level.name: Version identifier
top_level.definition: Identification of the version of a specific document/message number.

top_level.name: Reply type code
top_level.definition: Code specifying the type of reply required or transmitted.

top_level.name: Requested validity period quantity
top_level.definition: Quantity specifying the requested validity expressed in days (i.e., it will be a number of days indicated in the data field and not a period expressed as "from ? until ?").

top_level.name: Total number of items
top_level.definition: Quantity specifying the total number of goods items within a document.

top_level.name: Total invoice amount
top_level.definition: Amount indicating the total of all invoice amounts in a single declaration.

top_level.name: Number of loading lists
top_level.definition: Quantity specifying the number of loading lists, manifests or similar documents.

top_level.name: Jurisdiction (authority) date/time
top_level.definition: Date and time of landing, bringing, or introduction at any place subject to a country's jurisdiction whether or not such landing, bringing, or introduction constitutes an import (e.g. the date of import used in US tariff laws).

top_level.name: Total number of packages
top_level.definition: Quantity specifying the total number of packages of the entire document (e.g. declaration/consignment).

top_level.name: Number of seals
top_level.definition: Quantity specifying the number of seals affixed.

top_level.name: Transport movement code
top_level.definition: Code specifying a particular transport movement.

top_level.name: Specific circumstances code
top_level.definition: Code specifying circumstances for declarations.

top_level.name: Number of split-consignments
top_level.definition: Quantity specifying the total number of split-consignments for a transit declaration.

top_level.name: Safety and security code
top_level.definition: Code specifying whether the declaration is combined with safety and security related declarations.

top_level.name: Referral request identifier
top_level.definition:
Identification of the referral request received.
Note for EU CDM users:
This data element shall only be provided where the declaration is amended upon a referral request (Annex B DA).

top_level.name: Authentication
top_level.definition: Details related to the authentication of a document.

top_level.name: InsuranceCompany
top_level.definition: Details related to the company engaged in the business of insurance.

top_level.name: Submitter
top_level.definition: Details related to the submitter of written or electronic documentation.

top_level.name: DeclarationOffice
top_level.definition: Details related to the government office at which a declaration is lodged.

top_level.name: GoodsMeasure
top_level.definition: Details related to goods weight, quantities, and amounts.

top_level.name: SubsequentDeclarationOffice
top_level.definition: Details related to the customs office location of duty/tax payment at which a subsequent declaration is lodged.

top_level.name: Action
top_level.definition: Details related to an action taken on declaration data.

top_level.name: AdditionalDocument
top_level.definition: Details related to additional documents as part of a declaration or as part of a response.

top_level.name: AdditionalInformation
top_level.definition: Details related to the special request from declarant to government to take or not to take action.

top_level.name: AEOMutualRecognitionParty
top_level.definition: Details related to the role of the further parties in the supply chain having obtained a trusted trader certificate but otherwise not being identified in the declarations (e.g. warehouse keeper, freight forwarder).

top_level.name: Agent
top_level.definition: Details related to the party authorized to act on behalf of another party.

top_level.name: Amendment
top_level.definition: Details related to updating declaration data. Can cover the entire WCO Data Model.

top_level.name: ApprovedEstablishmentLocation
top_level.definition: Details related to a facility approved for a specific purpose by a government authority.

top_level.name: Authorization
top_level.definition: Details related to authorizations.

top_level.name: AuthorizationHolder
top_level.definition: Details related to the holder of the authorization.

top_level.name: Bank
top_level.definition: Details related to the requirement for payment to a financial institution.

top_level.name: BorderTransportMeans
top_level.definition: Details related to the means of transport crossing the border of the Customs territory.

top_level.name: Carrier
top_level.definition: Details related to the party undertaking or arranging transport of goods between named points.

top_level.name: CertificateOfResponsibilityHolder
top_level.definition: Details related to the party holding the Certificate of Financial Responsibility (COFR).

top_level.name: CompanySecurityOfficer
top_level.definition: Details related to the company security officer as described in IMO Circular MSC 1130.

top_level.name: Consignment
top_level.definition: Details related to the transport between a consignor and a consignee as specified in the transport contract document.

top_level.name: ContainerTerminalOperator
top_level.definition: Details related to the party operating a container terminal.

top_level.name: Control
top_level.definition: Details related to (governmental) examination.

top_level.name: CurrencyExchange
top_level.definition: Details related to rate at which one specified currency is expressed in another specified currency.

top_level.name: Declarant
top_level.definition: Details related to the party who makes a declaration to an official body or - where legally permitted - in whose name, or on whose behalf, a declaration to an official body is made.

top_level.name: DeclarationGuarantee
top_level.definition: Details related to the undertaking given in cash, bond or as a written guarantee to ensure that an obligation will be fulfilled (e.g. under a transit procedure) related to a declaration.

top_level.name: DeferredPayment
top_level.definition:
Details related to a deferred payment.
It may refer both to deferred payment of import and export duty and to tax credit.

top_level.name: DutyTaxFee
top_level.definition:
Details related to calculation of one instance of one duty, one tax, and/or one fee. 
Comment: Each instance of this class is to be used for a single occurrence of duty, tax or fee.

top_level.name: EntryOffice
top_level.definition: Details related to the office of entry.

top_level.name: ExitOffice
top_level.definition: Details related to the office of exit.

top_level.name: Exporter
top_level.definition: Details related to the person/party who makes or on whose behalf an export declaration is made.

top_level.name: ExportOffice
top_level.definition: Details related to the office of export where the export formalities are completed.

top_level.name: FinalTransportMeansLoadingLocation
top_level.definition: Details related to the location where a consignment is placed aboard the final means of transport for the journey to a customs territory of a country or union of countries.

top_level.name: GoodsShipment
top_level.definition: Details related to the movement and the handling of goods shipped together on one or more means of transport between original consignor and final consignee.

top_level.name: GovernmentProcedure
top_level.definition: Details related to the current and previous government procedure.

top_level.name: Importer
top_level.definition: Details related to the party who makes - or on whose behalf a customs clearing agent or other authorized person makes - an import declaration.

top_level.name: ISPSResponsibleParty
top_level.definition: Details related to the International Ship and Port Facility Security Code (ISPS) responsible party.

top_level.name: LandingLocation
top_level.definition: Details related to a landing place, wharf, or quay where ships may tie up and load, unload, or to lie at rest.

top_level.name: LoadingLocation
top_level.definition: Details related to the location at which the goods (i.e., consignments) are loaded on to the active means of transport.

top_level.name: NationalReference
top_level.definition: Details related to a national reference.

top_level.name: ObligationGuarantee
top_level.definition: Details related to the undertaking given in cash, bond or as a written guarantee to ensure that an obligation will be fulfilled (e.g. under a transit procedure).

top_level.name: Packaging
top_level.definition: Details related to packaging.

top_level.name: Payer
top_level.definition: Details related to the person/party paying an amount of duty.

top_level.name: PortFacilitySecurityOfficer
top_level.definition: Details related to the individual (i.e., person) designated as the port facility security officer responsible for port security requirements.

top_level.name: PresentationOffice
top_level.definition: Details related to the government agency office of presentation.

top_level.name: PreviousDocument
top_level.definition: Details related to the previous document.

top_level.name: TransitPrincipal
top_level.definition: Details related to the party accepting liability for goods held or moving under a customs authorization and - when applicable - a guarantee.

top_level.name: PropertyOperator
top_level.definition: Details related to the party which operates property.

top_level.name: PropertyOwner
top_level.definition: Details related to the party owning a property.

top_level.name: RecognizedSecurityOrganization
top_level.definition: Details related to the security organization granting the security certificate.

top_level.name: ReleaseOffice
top_level.definition: Details related to the requested office where the decision to release the goods declaration from customs custody is to be made.

top_level.name: RepresentativePerson
top_level.definition: Details related to the person acting as a representative.

top_level.name: ResponsibleGovernmentAgency
top_level.definition: Details related to the responsible government agency.

top_level.name: ShipChandler
top_level.definition: Details related to the retail dealer who specializes in supplies or equipment for ships, known as ship's stores.

top_level.name: ShipSecurityOfficer
top_level.definition: Details related to the officer who is appointed as Ship Security Officer.

top_level.name: ShipToShipActivityLocation
top_level.definition: Details related to the location where the ship-to-ship activity takes place.

top_level.name: SplitConsignment
top_level.definition: Details related to the consignment covered by the related transport document were split.

top_level.name: Status
top_level.definition: Details related to status.

top_level.name: Stevedore
top_level.definition: Details related to the stevedoring company.

top_level.name: SupervisingOffice
top_level.definition: Details related to the government agency office responsible for supervising the discharge of a government procedure.

top_level.name: SupplementaryDeclarant
top_level.definition: Details related to the supplementary declarant, for risk analysis purposes.

top_level.name: Surety
top_level.definition: Details related to the natural or legal person who accepts responsibility in due legal form for the financial consequences of non-fulfillment of another's obligations to the Customs (CCC).

top_level.name: Temperature
top_level.definition: Details related to temperature.

top_level.name: TransitOperationStartOffice
top_level.definition: Details related to the government agency office where the transit operation starts.

top_level.name: TravelDocument
top_level.definition: Details related to the travel document (e.g. passport).

top_level.name: UnloadingLocation
top_level.definition: Details related to the location at which the goods (i.e., consignment) are unloaded from the active means of transport having been used for their carriage.

top_level.name: UCR
top_level.definition: Details related to the Unique Trader Reference such as Unique Consignment Reference (UCR).
